newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Wah Lee seen in HK$70 mln IPO - sources.
newsitem.headline: HK's Wah Lee seen in HK$70 mln IPO - sources.

text.p: Air conditioning systems and audio visual products distributor Wah Lee Resources Holdings Ltd is expected to raise HK$70 million in an initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong, market sources said on Thursday.

Wah Lee is expected to issue 70 million new shares, or 25 percent of the enlarged share capital, at HK$1.00 per share, giving a prospective price to earnings multiple of about 6.6 times on a fully-diluted basis, they said.
Sources said the shares are expected to have attached warrants in the proportion of one warrant for every five shares subscribed.
Wah Lee forecasts its profit to be about HK$40 million for the year ending on June 30, 1997, they said.
The IPO is expected to kick off on December 31, with dealing in the shares expected to start in mid-January, sources said.
Lippo Securities is expected to be the sponsor of the issue, they said.
